desc: Parse input, store grid, Q, start position, and the sequence of moves and new values.
Implement the DP transformation for a single column/row (leaf) and a function to apply it to a vector.
Build a segment tree over the larger dimension, with each node storing a d×d matrix (use 1D arrays for speed).
Implement point update: update leaf matrix, then update ancestors using the rank-1 update propagation in O(d²) per level.
Maintain the global answer: after each update, compute the new total sum (from root matrix) and output modulo 998244353.
Verify that the solution passes all provided sample tests.
(Optional) Optimize for Python/PyPy with flat arrays and reduced overhead for potential large inputs.
